turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You are to rest and not worry about these things, O-lan. I will take care of everything, and our son will be well-provided for.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You will not be left alone, my son will wed the maid and then I will rest easy.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I-I don't know, honorable mother-in-law, I am but a lowly maid, how can I possibly be a wife to your son?

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: It is not for you to think of your station, but of what I want

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I am but a humble servant, and I do not have the skills to be a good wife, honorable mother-in-law

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: It is not for you to think of your station, but of what I want, and what I want is for you to be a wife to my son and to help him build a family.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry, I will take care of myself, and the maid will make a wonderful wife.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will see to it that you are prepared for your marriage, and I will make the necessary arrangements. Your son will take care of you, and you will be a good wife to him.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Do not worry, Mother, I will take good care of the maid and make sure she is happy with me.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I am but a simple woman, and I do not know if I can be a good wife to your son, honorable mother-in-law

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Do not worry, child, I will take care of you, and I will make sure you are well-prepared for your new life.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You will not be burdened with such worries, O-lan. I will make sure your son is settled and happy, and you can rest easy, knowing that everything is taken care of.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not be easy, Wang Lung, until I see my son wedded and settled. It is for this reason I want to live a little longer.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not think of such things, O-lan. You must rest and get well, for it is your duty to me and to our son.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I must see it for myself, Wang Lung, that my son is happy and settled, before I can die.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You have been through so much, O-lan, and I have been selfish, allowing your concerns for our son to weigh on you when you should be resting and getting well.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother-in-law, I have been making preparations for the wedding, as you instructed. I have been working on the bride's dowry, and I think it will be ready soon.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will be happy if you see me married and settled before you go, but I do not want you to worry about it. You must rest and get well, for I know Father will take care of me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you think you are strong, son, but I see it in your eyes, the worry and the doubt. You are not yet settled, and I will not die before you are.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please, you must listen to Father. He says you should rest and get well, and I know he will take care of me.

opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
